test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight row, facing north. S is an immediate neighbour of both T and R. R is an immediate neighbour of Q. If Q is at the extreme right end of the row, then who is sitting at the extreme left end?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information is as:

1. Q is at the extreme right end of the row.
